the_signal.headline: API contract testing catches breaking changes before production hits
the_signal.body: n8n's fresh take on API contract testing shows GTM teams how to prevent workflow failures at scale. This isn't theoretical—it's the operational pattern between 'automation works in dev' and 'automation breaks at 2am.' If you're shipping AI workflows that depend on external APIs, contract testing becomes your early warning system.
